channel.title: Blocktape
channel.description: Blocktape reports crypto news: exchange and market moves, protocol upgrades, token launches, security incidents, regulation and enforcement across chains.

item.title: Consensys launches stack to link institutional ledgers
item.description: Consensys launched a four-workflow stack for routing institutional transactions across independent ledgers, keeping assets on native networks as EVM connections open.

item.title: When does shiba swap make sense for a token trade?
item.description: ShibaSwap can suit a token trade when its pool route offers a fair price after fees, gas and slippage; compare the final amount before you confirm.

item.title: Akash stakers approve Solana move, staking ends at cutover
item.description: Akash voters approved moving the protocol from Cosmos to Solana, authorizing a 1:1 AKT token launch; current staking continues until a separate cutover vote.

item.title: Bitcoin slips below $76,000 as AI selloff hits crypto stocks
item.description: Bitcoin fell below $76,000 as AI-linked shares sold off, pulling down crypto companies and triggering more than $1 billion in leveraged liquidations.

item.title: CFTC opens US market to single-stock perpetual futures
item.description: The CFTC says single-stock perpetual futures can begin trading on registered US exchanges, with SEC notice registration required for security-futures markets.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview preceded $6.34B hack
item.description: Binance says a September fake interview helped attackers reach wallet systems before $6.34 billion in tokens were stolen on Oct. 30; its review continues.

item.title: Binance says fake interview led to $6.34 billion theft
item.description: Binance says a September fake interview led to malware that helped attackers steal $6.34 billion in late October, exposing wallet systems and prompting an independent review.

item.title: Binance halts trading after $6.3 billion hot-wallet breach
item.description: Binance halted trading after a $6.3 billion hot-wallet breach, then said it would cover the loss as it works to restore withdrawals and freeze funds.

item.title: Binance resumes withdrawals after $6.3B hack, sees outflows
item.description: Binance restarted withdrawals on Sunday after a $6.3 billion wallet breach, while customers withdrew a net $4.72 billion, testing confidence in the exchange.

item.title: FBI Ties Binance’s $6B Hack to North Korea’s TraderTraitor
item.description: The FBI says North Korea’s TraderTraitor group stole more than $6 billion from Binance on Oct. 29 and urges crypto services to block laundering addresses.

item.title: FBI links $6bn Binance theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor
item.description: The FBI says North Korean hackers stole more than $6 billion from Binance on Oct. 29 and are converting assets into ether as investigators seek to freeze funds.

item.title: Binance estimates security incident impact at $6.3 billion
item.description: Binance estimates a security incident affected $6.3 billion, with about $3 billion frozen on-chain; withdrawals remain paused during security checks and recovery.

item.title: Binance estimates $6.3B impact from security incident
item.description: Binance put the incident’s estimated impact at $6.3 billion, said about $3 billion was frozen and suspended deposits and withdrawals during its investigation.

item.title: JPMorgan launches JPM Coin on Ethereum for institutions
item.description: JPMorgan has launched its dollar deposit token on Ethereum for institutional clients, adding a second public network for peer-to-peer transfers alongside Base.

item.title: Ripple says OCC approved its national trust bank charter
item.description: Ripple says the OCC approved its national trust bank on Oct. 26, authorizing RLUSD reserve management and fiduciary custody under federal supervision.

item.title: How to Choose a Rango Bridge Route
item.description: Choose a Rango bridge route by checking the destination network, expected output, fees and steps, then confirm the wallet requirements before signing.

item.title: Why Impermanent Loss Happens in a SushiSwap Pool
item.description: Impermanent loss is the value gap between holding two tokens and supplying them to a SushiSwap pool; price moves widen it, while fees can offset it.

item.title: HSBC launches RedCoin stablecoin on PayMe in Hong Kong
item.description: HSBC launched RedCoin, its HKD stablecoin, on PayMe on Oct. 23, with wallets for more than 3.3 million users due to roll out over the following days.

item.title: HSBC launches RedCoin for PayMe users in Hong Kong
item.description: HSBC launched RedCoin on PayMe on Oct. 23, opening HKD stablecoin payments to more than 3.3 million users and planning app-based tokenised investments.

item.title: Bitcoin Core speeds fixes for bugs AI can easily rediscover
item.description: Bitcoin Core added an easily discoverable category, directing fast fixes and advisories for bugs an LLM can find with minimal effort, while other flaws keep timed embargoes.
